senses.gloss:
खिलः, -लम्
 [खिल्-क]
—1 A piece of waste or uncultivated land, desert or bare soil; a desert,
 waste; खिले गा विष्ठिता इव Av. 7. 115. 4.
—2 A gap, vacant place.
—3 An additional hymn appended to the regular collection; Ms. 3. 232.
—4 A supplement in general.
—5 A compendium, compilation.
—6 Vacuity.
—7 Remainder; अलं दग्धैर्द्रुमैर्दीनैः खिलानां शिवमस्तु नः Bhāg. 6. 4. 15.

खिलः, -लम् + .{@-लः@} N. of Brahmā and of Viṣṇu. [खिल is often used in
 combination with भू and कृ; (1) खिलीभू
——(a) to become impassable, to be blocked up, be left unfrequented;
 खिलीभूते विमानानां तदापातभयात्पथि Ku. 2. 45.
——(b) to be impossible, be rendered impracticable or stopped; प्रजागरात्खिलीभूतस्तस्याः
 स्वप्नसमागमः Ś. 6. 22. (2) खिलीकृ means
——(a) to obstruct, impede, make impassable, block up; तौ सुकेतसुतया
 खिलीकृते R. 11. 14, 87.
——(b) to lay waste, devastate, put down or vanquish completely; विपक्षमखिलीकृत्य
 प्रतिष्ठा खलु दुर्लभा Śi. 2. 34.]

खिल्यः Ved.
—1 A desert; उत खिल्या उर्वराणां भवन्ति Rv. 10. 142. 3.
—2 A piece of rock in the earth; अभिन्ने खिल्ये नि दधाति देवयुम् Rv. 6. 28. 2.
